reviews.rationale: Sequential GAAP comparison of selected SEC exhibit rows shows a materially higher revenue and operating-profit quarter, but the improvement is concentrated in license revenue while the recurring software-as-a-service and platform-as-a-service line declined sequentially and services also softened. Because the selected rows do not disclose the mix, contract-timing, or cost drivers behind that shift, the durability of the profit improvement cannot be established from this extract, and the recurring-revenue direction is opposing evidence against treating the quarter as a clean strengthening of the thesis. Tax expense rose alongside pretax income, so the after-tax result reflects a larger tax charge rather than a reduced one. No company-defined non-GAAP measures, guidance, or realized-versus-guided comparisons are present in the selected rows, so no beat/miss or guidance conclusion is drawn. The thesis carries required event metrics that are present in the alert, but the causal and durability questions remain unresolved; the research state is therefore held for review rather than upgraded, with conviction and status preserved.
